notes.title: The Lychees are ready to face you!
notes.content:
Hello to every vegangster out there!

We have upgraded our demo. Now you can take down the Lychees!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684157/35084c74092b180de345461f5cec6a6a3a3a4c51.png[/img]

And remember, if you haven't requested access yet, click the green button "Request Access" on the Vegangsters Steam store page.

Also, don't forget to get into our Discord if you haven't already:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/Vmw4WwtCt3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684157/9ef43021dbec44fd255d8c9e065f34aecbb4f66c.png[/img][/url]

It's a great way to give us feedback and chat with other players.

Thank you for everything!

- Poison Pill Games

notes.title: The Playtest of Vegangsters has officially launched!
notes.content:
Hello to every vegangster out there!

In the next days we will be granting access to some of you so we can gather useful information.

If you haven't requested access yet, click the green button "Request Access" on the Vegangsters Steam store page.

Also, don't forget to get into our Discord if you haven't already:

[url=https://discord.com/invite/Vmw4WwtCt3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44684157/9ef43021dbec44fd255d8c9e065f34aecbb4f66c.png[/img]
[/url]
It's a great way to give us feedback and chat with other players.

 Thank you for everything!
